games.rules: Unmodified game, any difficulty and patch (state them). A chapter counts when its final boss is defeated and the chapter-end sequence plays.

attempts.name: VARP (Vision Action Role-Playing agent)
attempts.name_zh: VARP（视觉动作角色扮演智能体）
attempts.team: Peng Chen, Pi Bu, Jun Song, Yuan Gao, Bo Zheng
attempts.result: Screenshots in, keyboard and mouse out, with the game paused in photo mode while the model thinks. On 12 short Chapter 1 tasks, mostly fights, it wins about 90% of easy and medium fights. Against Bullguard it wins 20% of tries, a little above novice human players (15.63%). Walking to Bullguard within five minutes fails without human-guided examples and succeeds 40% of the time with them.
attempts.result_zh: 输入截图，输出键盘鼠标操作；模型思考时用拍照模式暂停游戏。在第一章的 12 个短任务（大多是战斗）里，简单和中等难度的战斗胜率约 90%。对牯护院（Bullguard）的胜率是 20%，略高于新手玩家的 15.63%。五分钟内走到牯护院的任务，没有人类示范时失败，有示范时成功率 40%。
attempts.why_not: Single fights and short tasks inside Chapter 1, five tries each. No chapter was finished, so no milestone is reached.
attempts.why_not_zh: 只测试第一章里的单场战斗和短任务，每项试 5 次。没有打完任何一章，所以没有达成里程碑。

attempts.name: CombatVLA
attempts.result: A small vision-language-action model trained for combat: game frames in, keyboard and mouse out, with the game paused while it thinks. Tested on 10 Wukong fights, from wolf guards up to Bullguard, Wandering Wight and Guangzhi, plus 3 Sekiro fights. It takes 1.85 s per decision against 90 s for VARP, and the authors report higher success than human players on their tasks.
attempts.result_zh: 一个专为战斗训练的小型视觉-语言-动作模型：输入游戏画面，输出键盘鼠标操作，思考时暂停游戏。测试了 10 场悟空战斗（从狼族小妖到牯护院、幽魂和广智），外加 3 场只狼战斗。每次决策用 1.85 秒，VARP 要 90 秒；作者称它在这些任务上的成功率高于人类玩家。
attempts.why_not: Isolated fights only. No chapter was finished.
attempts.why_not_zh: 只打单场战斗，没有打完任何一章。

games.description: The classic long-horizon tech tree: wood to diamonds to the Nether to the End. Milestones follow official advancements, so a reviewer can check them from the toast on screen. The only clear so far, by four Gemini agents, never looked at the screen: they read the game state and acted through the Mineflayer bot API. The furthest any screen-watching agent has got is GPT-6 Astra, which reached the blaze rods.

games.rules: Survival mode, random seed, no cheats or mods that change gameplay. State version and difficulty. Bot APIs such as Mineflayer go in the Harness track; screen + keyboard/mouse is Pixels-only. Milestones need not be reached in order.

attempts.name: Voyager
attempts.team: NVIDIA, Caltech, UT Austin, Stanford and UW–Madison
attempts.team_zh: 英伟达、加州理工学院、得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校、斯坦福大学、威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
attempts.result: A GPT-4 agent that reads the world as text and writes JavaScript skills for the Mineflayer bot API, building up a skill library. Within 160 prompting rounds it reached iron tools in all 3 trials and a diamond tool in 1 of 3. In a fresh world, reusing its skills, it made a diamond pickaxe in about 19 rounds.
attempts.result_zh: 一个 GPT-4 智能体：以文本形式读取世界，为 Mineflayer 机器人 API 编写 JavaScript 技能，逐步积累技能库。在 160 轮提示之内，3 次试验全部做出铁制工具，其中 1 次做出钻石工具。在新世界里复用已学技能，约 19 轮就做出了钻石镐。
attempts.why_not: The setup uses cheat commands: it is handed a crafting table, a furnace and a replacement iron pickaxe with /give, keeps its inventory on death and plays on Peaceful. Mineflayer itself would be fine in the Harness track.
attempts.why_not_zh: 运行设置用了作弊指令：用 /give 直接给它工作台、熔炉和替换的铁镐，死亡不掉落物品，并且在和平难度下进行。单用 Mineflayer 本身是可以进工具辅助赛道的。

attempts.name: DreamerV3
attempts.team: Google DeepMind and University of Toronto (Nature 2025)
attempts.team_zh: Google DeepMind 与多伦多大学（Nature 2025）
attempts.result: A reinforcement-learning agent with a learned world model, trained from scratch without human data. It sees a 64×64 image plus its inventory and chooses among 25 actions. It was the first agent to collect diamonds this way: across 40 training runs, 50 of its 30-minute episodes ended with diamonds.
attempts.result_zh: 一个带有学习型世界模型的强化学习智能体，从零开始训练，不用任何人类数据。它看到 64×64 的画面和物品栏，从 25 个动作中选择。它是第一个以这种方式采到钻石的智能体：40 次训练中，共有 50 个 30 分钟的回合采到了钻石。
attempts.why_not: Blocks break 100 times faster than normal, crafting and smelting are single actions instead of the crafting menu, and it runs Minecraft 1.11.2, which predates most of the advancements used as milestones here.
attempts.why_not_zh: 方块的破坏速度是正常的 100 倍，合成和熔炼是一步完成的动作而不是通过合成界面，而且用的是 Minecraft 1.11.2，比本榜用作里程碑的大部分进度都早。

attempts.name: Claude Code plays Factorio
attempts.result: Claude Code played through a custom command-line tool that sends Lua over RCON, with no screenshots. Over two runs it powered labs with boilers and steam engines, made red and green science, and was about halfway through researching Automation 2 when the authors stopped the second run.
attempts.result_zh: Claude Code 通过一个自制命令行工具玩游戏，工具经 RCON 发送 Lua 指令，不看截图。两轮运行中，它用锅炉和蒸汽机给研究中心供电，生产了红、绿两种科技包；作者停止第二轮时，「自动化 2」研究进行到一半左右。
attempts.why_not: The tool let it reach anything without walking and mine with no delay, which the authors call cheating. Map settings, times and video are not given.
attempts.why_not_zh: 这个工具让它不用走路就能操作任何东西，采矿也没有延迟，作者自己也称之为作弊。没有给出地图设置、用时和录像。

attempts.name: BALROG
attempts.team_zh: 伦敦大学学院 AI 中心等（ICLR 2025）
attempts.result: LLM agents play NetHack as text, zero-shot. Progress is scored as the chance that a human who reached the same dungeon or experience level went on to win. The leaderboard's best is GPT-6 Astra Max at 13.2% average progression; when the paper came out the best was o1-preview at about 1.5%.
attempts.result_zh: LLM 智能体以文本形式零样本玩 NetHack。进度的算法是：到达同样地牢层数或经验等级的人类玩家最终获胜的概率。排行榜上最好的是 GPT-6 Astra Max，平均进度 13.2%；论文发表时最好的是 o1-preview，约 1.5%。
attempts.why_not: An average over runs on a probability scale, not the milestones of a single run.
attempts.why_not_zh: 这是多局在一个概率刻度上的平均值，不是单局达成的里程碑。

attempts.name: NetHack Challenge (NeurIPS 2021)
attempts.team: Competition on the NetHack Learning Environment
attempts.team_zh: 基于 NetHack 学习环境的比赛
attempts.result: The winner, the rule-based bot AutoAscend, had a median score of about 5,300, and the best rule-based entries scored nearly three times the best neural ones. In over half a million evaluation games, no agent ascended.
attempts.result_zh: 冠军是基于规则的机器人 AutoAscend，得分中位数约 5,300；最好的规则型参赛作品得分接近最好的神经网络作品的三倍。在超过 50 万局评测中，没有任何智能体飞升。
attempts.why_not: Scores are summarized over many games; no individual game has been submitted with its recording.
attempts.why_not_zh: 成绩是对大量对局的汇总，没有提交任何一局的录像。

games.title: Slay the Spire
games.description: Turn-based, but each run is a long chain of decisions. Benchmarks report win rates; here a single submitted run counts, so state the character and Ascension level.
games.clear_condition: Defeat the Act 3 boss (standard victory). The Corrupt Heart is a post-game milestone.
games.rules: Any character, any Ascension level (state both). One run per submission; for win rates, link the full set of runs in notes.

attempts.name: SpireBench
attempts.team: Scott C. Lowe (Vector Institute) and Sander W. Keemink (Radboud University)
attempts.team_zh: Scott C. Lowe（Vector 研究所）与 Sander W. Keemink（拉德堡德大学）
attempts.result: Twenty LLMs play the Ironclad at Ascension 20 through a mod that sends the game state as text, 10 runs each on held-out seeds. 4 of the 200 runs beat the Act 3 boss: Claude Fable 5.1 twice, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol once each, and the Sol run went on to kill the Heart. For comparison, human players average 0.73 acts cleared and the expert Baalorlord 2.98.
attempts.result_zh: 20 个 LLM 通过一个把游戏状态转成文本的模组，用铁甲战士在进阶 20 下游玩，每个模型在预留种子上跑 10 局。200 局中有 4 局击败了第三幕 Boss：Claude Fable 5.1 两次，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 各一次，其中 Sol 那局还击杀了腐化之心。作为对比，人类玩家平均通过 0.73 幕，高手 Baalorlord 平均 2.98 幕。
attempts.why_not: Those four winning runs would rank here, but none is public: the runs were logged to Weights & Biases with no public link.
attempts.why_not_zh: 这 4 局胜利本可以上榜，但都没有公开：运行记录存在 Weights & Biases 上，没有公开链接。

attempts.name: SpireClimb
attempts.result: Models play the normal game from screenshots, 15 single attempts per model, character and game. At Ascension 0, GPT-6 Astra wins 98% of runs, GPT-6.1 Sol 97% and Claude Opus 5.5 93%. At Ascension 20 with the Heart required, the best is GPT-6.1 Sol at 20%. Slay the Spire 2 is tested too.
attempts.result_zh: 模型看截图玩原版游戏，每个模型、每个角色、每款游戏各尝试 15 次。进阶 0 下，GPT-6 Astra 胜率 98%，GPT-6.1 Sol 97%，Claude Opus 5.5 93%。进阶 20 且要求击杀腐化之心时，最好的是 GPT-6.1 Sol，20%。同时也测试了《杀戮尖塔 2》。
attempts.why_not: Reports win rates over many runs; no single run is published with a log or video to check.
attempts.why_not_zh: 只报告多局的胜率，没有公开任何一局可供核对的日志或录像。

games.title: Pokémon Crystal
games.description: Longer than Red/Blue, with a second region after the credits. The story clear is the Champion; the 16-badge post-game and Red are tracked as extra milestones.
games.clear_condition: Defeat Champion Lance and enter the Hall of Fame. Post-game milestones (Kanto badges, Red) rank above that.
games.rules: Unmodified ROM on an emulator or original hardware. Emulator speed-up allowed if disclosed.

links.label: Gemini 3 Pro vs 2.5 Pro in Crystal (author write-up)

games.description: Used by the NeurIPS 2025 PokeAgent speedrun track, which only went as far as the first gym. No full AI clear is known yet.
games.clear_condition: Defeat Champion Wallace and enter the Hall of Fame.

games.title: Pokémon Red / Blue
games.description: The most-attempted game for LLM agents. Several models have finished it, each with a different harness, which is exactly why the board separates tracks and asks for harness details.
games.clear_condition: Defeat the Champion and enter the Hall of Fame.
games.rules: Red or Blue (any language), unmodified ROM on an emulator or original hardware. Emulator speed-up allowed if disclosed. FireRed/LeafGreen are a different game and not eligible for this board.
games.timing: Elapsed run time from New Game. Step counts may be given in notes.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX
games.description: A dungeon-gated adventure with puzzles and item gating. VideoGameBench agents scored 0% on it in 2025.
games.clear_condition: Defeat the final boss in the Wind Fish's Egg and wake the Wind Fish.
games.rules: Unmodified ROM. The optional Color Dungeon is not a milestone.

attempts.name: VideoGameBench
attempts.result: Vision-language models played Link's Awakening DX in one fixed harness and scored 0%.
attempts.result_zh: 视觉-语言模型在同一个固定框架下玩《塞尔达传说：织梦岛 DX》，得分 0%。
attempts.why_not: No dungeon cleared.
attempts.why_not_zh: 没有通关任何一个迷宫。

games.title: Super Mario Bros.
games.description: Short, real-time and deterministic. LLM benchmarks score how far Mario travels, not levels cleared; a full 8-4 clear by a general agent has not been reported.
games.rules: Unmodified ROM. Warp zones allowed (say so). Save states may not be used by the agent during the run.

human_baselines.note: speedrun.com world record by Niftski (4:54.299, with warps)

attempts.name: lmgame-Bench
attempts.team: UC San Diego, MBZUAI and UC Berkeley
attempts.team_zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校、MBZUAI、加州大学伯克利分校
attempts.result: Scores how far Mario travels in total across levels before losing three lives. The best was o3 with a perception harness that turns the screen into text, at 3,445 units in a single run; without the harness GPT-4.1 averaged 1,991, against 987 for random play.
attempts.result_zh: 以马里奥在丢掉三条命之前累计前进的水平距离计分。最好的是 o3，配合一个把画面转成文字的感知框架，单局 3,445 单位；不用框架时 GPT-4.1 平均 1,991，随机操作是 987。
attempts.why_not: The paper reports distance only, not which levels or worlds were cleared.
attempts.why_not_zh: 论文只报告距离，没有说通过了哪些关卡或世界。

method.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 driving the game through a Lua mod and an MCP server whose policy is to expose only what a player could see. Beat the Netherbrain on its 12th attempt and played the ending.
method.interface: Game state from a Lua mod, limited to what a player could see → MCP tool calls
method.interface_zh: 通过 Lua 模组读取游戏状态（仅限玩家可见的信息）→ MCP 工具调用
method.observation: Game state from a Lua mod via MCP, limited to player-visible information
method.action: MCP tool calls (20,809 over the run)
method.human_intervention: The author fixed the harness between sessions
method.restarts: Save reloads allowed; 91 of 149 fights used at least one

submissions.notes: Explorer difficulty (the easiest). Self-reported by the author, not a controlled measurement. Only the final time is published, so the earlier milestones are untimed and the 38.9 h total is marked approximate.

method.summary: Vals AI Time Horizon Index: a 30-rung KSP mission ladder with a 120-hour budget, run in the OpenCode harness and scored from telemetry. Rung 2 is a Mun landing and safe return of the same Kerbal. Vals reports Claude Opus 5.5 verified all 27 missions through the Eve landing (91.33%).
method.interface: Coding-agent harness (OpenCode); how it sees and controls the game isn't stated
method.interface_zh: 编程智能体框架（OpenCode）；如何观察和操控游戏未说明

submissions.notes: Game version and mode are not stated, and no per-rung timing is published, so this run is not plotted. The Mun landing and return is claimed because Vals reports every mission up to rung 27 verified.

submissions.game_version: Not stated in the paper; the released code uses MineRL 1.0 (Minecraft 1.16.5)

method.summary: A model pretrained on 70,000 hours of unlabeled Minecraft video (actions inferred by an inverse dynamics model), then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning toward a diamond pickaxe. With RL it makes an iron pickaxe in over 80% of 10-minute episodes, collects diamonds in almost 20% and crafts a diamond pickaxe in 2.5%.
method.interface: Screen pixels → keyboard and mouse at 20 Hz
method.interface_zh: 屏幕像素 → 键盘鼠标（20 Hz）
models: VPT foundation model (~0.5B parameters) with RL fine-tuning
method.observation: Raw pixels with the HUD, 128x128 (rendered at 640x360)
method.action: Full keyboard and mouse at 20 Hz, crafting through the normal crafting GUI
method.restarts: Fresh survival world each episode; on death the agent drops its items and respawns, and the episode continues

submissions.notes: The paper reports rates over many 10-minute episodes; the milestones are those of its best episodes, where diamonds were collected (iron pickaxe, smelted iron and stone tools are required to mine diamonds). Each episode lasts 10 minutes, so 0:10:00 is an upper bound. Difficulty and seed are not stated. No full-episode video has been checked.

extra_sources.label: Vals AI post on X (not opened)

videos.label: Early segment (Vals AI upload)
videos.covers: 3-hour upload by Vals AI: early game through building a Nether portal; does not show the blaze rods

method.summary: General computer-use agent (screen in, mouse and keyboard out). Collected 6 blaze rods and 3 ender pearls; stopped after 141 hours without reaching the dragon.
method.interface_zh: 截图 → 键盘鼠标（计算机操作）

submissions.notes: Milestones up to smelting iron are claimed because Vals AI’s 3-hour upload shows the agent building a Nether portal, and in practice its obsidian takes iron: a bucket to cast it from lava, or a diamond pickaxe, which needs an iron pickaxe first. The iron pickaxe and diamonds are not claimed, since a bucket is enough. Reported via press, not verified. The 141h time is when the run was stopped, so it is an upper bound for reaching the blaze rods.

submissions.team: Faldor, Singh, Raileanu (reported as Google DeepMind)

method.summary: Four Gemini agents controlling bots through Mineflayer (JavaScript API), Easy difficulty, Minecraft 1.20.4. Killed the Ender Dragon in a single run after 27h14m and 605 deaths.
method.interface: Game state as data from the Mineflayer bot API → bot commands; never sees the screen
method.interface_zh: 通过 Mineflayer 机器人 API 读取结构化游戏状态 → 机器人指令；完全不看画面

submissions.notes: Earlier milestones are inferred from the clear; diamonds are not strictly required. The paper says logs were recorded but links no video or logs. The DeepMind affiliation comes from press coverage. Intermediate times are read from the paper's progress chart (time since the first program); the chart marks team steps, so 'We Need to Go Deeper' uses the portal-lit time and 'Eye Spy' the End-portal-lit time. Crafting table and diamonds are not timed separately. The times include about 20 minutes of server restarts.

method.summary: GPT-6 Astra driven through Codex with a self-built harness and open access to the NetHack wiki and spoilers. Ascended a Dwarf Valkyrie in 37,140 turns on the third attempt; a Hardfought dumplog is published.
method.interface: Text terminal through a self-built Codex harness, with the wiki and spoilers open
method.interface_zh: 通过自建的 Codex 框架操作文字终端，可查阅 wiki 和攻略
method.human_intervention: A human handled setup and resumed sessions (as reported).

submissions.notes: NetHack 3.6.7. Minetown and Sokoban are not claimed (not required for ascension); the other milestones follow from the ascension. No video found; the evidence is ttyrec recordings and dumplogs. Times are active play hours, estimated from the replay viewer's timeline with long idle pauses removed; they are not a published figure. Wall-clock from start to ascension was about 294 hours across 12 days. Medusa's time is an upper bound (arrival at the Castle). The Quest was entered after Gehennom (turn 28,330).

method.summary: GPT-5 in the GPT Plays Pokémon harness; beat Red in 9,517 steps (o3: 27,040).
method.interface: Screenshots plus harness tools (GPT Plays Pokémon) → button presses
method.interface_zh: 截图加框架工具（GPT Plays Pokémon）→ 按键

submissions.notes: Self-reported. Times come from a community timing sheet and match the operator's archived badge log; they include about 3 hours of downtime. Elite Four times are upper bounds: when the agent first walked into the next room, from the archived room-visit log. The Elite Four took several attempts, so these are the first wins, not the winning pass. Defeating Red implies all 16 badges and the Champion.

method.summary: Gemini 3 Pro in the Gemini Plays Pokémon harness: 16 badges, Elite Four, Lance and Red in about 17 days. Gemini 2.5 Pro in the same harness stalled at 4 badges.
method.interface: Screenshots plus harness tools (Gemini Plays Pokémon) → button presses
method.interface_zh: 截图加框架工具（Gemini Plays Pokémon）→ 按键

submissions.notes: Red was defeated at turn 24,178 using 1.88B tokens (operator's blog). Times are harness session hours read from the operator's milestone chart. They include about 74 hours of API downtime; with that removed, the operator's sheet gives about 350 hours to Red. Elite Four times are from the per-turn notepad commits on GitHub, converted to hours. A later full-game timelapse exists for a different Gemini 3 Pro run on a 'continuous thinking' harness; it is not this run.

method.summary: NeurIPS 2025 PokeAgent speedrun-track winner: LLM-written scripted policies distilled into a neural network, then RL fine-tuning. Reached the first gym badge in 40:13.
method.interface: Scripted policies written by LLMs, distilled into a neural network → button presses
method.interface_zh: 由 LLM 编写的脚本策略蒸馏成神经网络 → 按键

submissions.notes: The competition ended at the first gym; per the paper, a top human speedrunner takes about 18 minutes to get there. No video of this run was found.

method.summary: Claude 3.7 Sonnet with a tool harness, streamed on Twitch. Reached 3 badges.
method.interface: Screenshots plus harness tools (Claude Plays Pokémon) → button presses
method.interface_zh: 截图加框架工具（Claude Plays Pokémon）→ 按键

submissions.notes: Anthropic's post reports 3 gym badges from internal testing; the badge count reached on the public Twitch stream was not separately verified. The plotted times are from the public stream's restarted run (begun around 2025-03-05), which reached Thunder after about 307 hours; a community sheet estimated them from VODs. The stream's first run stalled at 2 badges and was reset.

method.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro playing Pokémon Blue through a custom harness (including a minimap and pathfinding help). First completion May 2, 2025 after about 813 hours; a second run on June 9, 2025 finished in about 406 hours.
method.interface: Screenshots plus a minimap and pathfinding help → button presses
method.interface_zh: 截图加小地图和寻路辅助 → 按键
method.human_intervention: One manual context clear during this run (operator's blog). The second run reports zero manual interventions.

submissions.notes: Played Blue. Badge and Champion times come from a community timing sheet, which estimated them from a Google progress graph and Discord timestamps; the Elite Four fights are not timed one by one. The harness was changed during the run and the operator stepped in at times.

method.summary: GPT-5 in the GPT Plays Pokémon harness; finished Pokémon Red in 6,470 steps (the same harness with o3 took 18,184 steps).
method.interface: Screenshots plus harness tools (GPT Plays Pokémon) → button presses
method.interface_zh: 截图加框架工具（GPT Plays Pokémon）→ 按键

submissions.notes: Finished in 6,470 steps. Badge times come from the operator's archived badge log and match a community timing sheet; the start (2025-08-07 18:16 UTC) is derived from that log. Elite Four times are upper bounds: when the agent first walked into the next room, from the archived room-visit log. method.summary: General Computer Control agent: GPT-4V (later GPT-4o) with information gathering, self-reflection, task inference, skill curation, action planning and memory modules. Plays from screenshots through keyboard and mouse. Played through the Chapter 1 story missions, ending with Eastward Bound.

submissions.notes: Chapter 1 clear (Eastward Bound) checked against the official Chapter 1 video by a maintainer. Run time is estimated from that video: 7:28 at 16× speed ≈ 1:59:28 of play. The upload may be trimmed, so the real run could have been longer. Hardware was not disclosed.
